issues.issue: Did the Board err in its negative credibility finding?
issues.applicant_position: Board drew negative inferences without evidence Hezbollah could find or warrant him in 2000; relied on non-existent Exhibit C-4; delay finding unreasonable.
issues.result_quote: the Board erred by drawing negative inferences in respect of each issue.

issues.issue: Did the Board breach natural justice by not putting its work-history concern to the PA?
issues.applicant_position: Board breached natural justice by not putting its concern about work in Saika until August 2000; the PA could have explained it.
issues.result_quote: There was no breach of natural justice.

issues.issue: Did the Board apply an incorrect standard of proof for well-founded fear under s. 96?
issues.applicant_position: Board required clear and convincing evidence of risk, an unduly high standard rather than a serious possibility of persecution.
issues.result_quote: The Board therefore erred in applying an incorrect standard of proof to the applicants’ well-founded fear of persecution in its section 96 analysis.
